title: Managing Quality and the Sales Process

flashcard_questions.q: A measure of excellence — how well made a product is, or how well a service meets customer expectations.
The process of checking the standard of products at the end of the production process to identify defects before they reach customers.
Employees whose role is to check products for defects and ensure quality standards are met.

flashcard_questions.a: Support given to customers after they have bought a product, such as warranties, repairs and returns.
A proactive approach where quality is managed at every stage of the production process, aiming to prevent defects rather than detect them.
